body_lead: Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation stone for $15 bn Google AI data centre near Visakhapatnam Adani Group announced a $100 billion investment plan to develop integrated infrastructure across renewable energy, power transmission, and data centres. Andhra Pradesh chief minister N Chandrababu Naidu on Tuesday laid the foundation stone for a $15 billion Google Artificial Intelligence data centre near Visakhapatnam, marking a major push to India’s digital infrastructure.
